text:
Marta (Finance): Flagging SilverLine invoice SL-2107 for 8,400 (EUR) — Coupa attempted to match to PO 2107 (USD) so it failed. Vendor says PO 2107-EU issued under SilverLine EU entity. Due in 2 days.
Diego (ProcureOps): Upload invoice and vendor portal screenshot please. This smells like an entity / supplier-id mapping problem.
invoicer-bot: Invoice SL-2107 uploaded by supplier id 7723 (auto-match confidence: 0%). Currency mismatch detected.
Silverline-AR (vendor): Hi Redwood team, PO 2107-EU was created by our buyer contact on 2025-03-10. We invoiced in EUR per contract. AR phone: +44 20 7946 0000.
Marta (Finance): Attached PDF and PO screenshot. Bank last4 5566. Our Coupa only has PO 2107 assigned to SilverLine US (supplier id 1102). EU entity is supplier id 7733 but not linked to PO.
Nora (Platform): This PO originated from PR-2107-IO for EMEA infra. PR shows region EMEA but procurement defaulted to global supplier id.
Diego (ProcureOps): Options: 1) Remap invoice to supplier 7733 and create retro PO 2107-EU; 2) Ask vendor to reissue invoice in USD against PO 2107-US (bad for them due to FX); 3) Create a one-off clearing memo. Need legal/ops sign-off.
Laila (Legal EMEA): If the contract binds EU entity and currency is EUR, we must not force USD without vendor consent. Legal OKs retro PO if Ops confirms services and signs an entity justification memo.
Omar (APAC Ops): Ops confirms services delivered in EMEA. I can sign the justification memo.
Ken (Payments): Treasury needs GL and confirmation on whether we can pay in EUR. We support EUR payments but prefer vendor mapping fixed before sweep. We can do a manual wire if approved.
Marta (Finance): GL: 5302-EMEA-INFRA. Vendor will accept EUR wire. They asked to waive 1.5% finance charge if paid within 48hrs.
Diego (ProcureOps): I'll create retro PO 2107-EU-retro, remap supplier 7733 in Coupa and route to Omar for Ops approval and to Laila for legal ACK. Add note: "Entity mismatch; retro PO to clear SL-2107 (EUR)."
Silverline-AR (vendor): We can waive the 1.5% fee if payment is sent by 2025-03-18 EOD. Otherwise charge applies.
Nora (Platform): Confirming PR and delivery logs. Good to proceed.
Laila (Legal EMEA): I'll ACK commercial acceptance (not countersign) once ProcureOps attaches the PO and vendor portal export.
Ken (Payments): Once PO matched and approvals recorded, we can queue an expedited EUR wire. Confirm Treasury window and fees.
Marta (Finance): Please set priority. I'm marking invoice on hold until PO exists but will release immediately after approvals.
Diego (ProcureOps): Created PO 2107-EU-retro in Coupa (status: pending). Tagging Omar and Laila.
invoicer-bot: PO 2107-EU-retro created (auto-link pending).
Omar (APAC Ops): Approved. Signed justification memo attached.
Laila (Legal EMEA): ACK commercial acceptance.
Ken (Payments): Noted  will schedule EUR wire once Finance marks matched. Expect fees ~€25.
Marta (Finance): Thanks all :raised_hands: 1.5% fee waived per vendor. Will mark matched and request expedited sweep now.
